goals: Verify the performance and stability of the API endpoints for user profiles, group management, and bill splitting under simulated random user load.
activities: Register a first user with a random username and password
Register a second user with a random username and password
Register a third user with a random username and password, and extract the authentication token and user ID
Create a new group containing the three registered users and extract the group ID
Randomly select an action number between 1 and 4
If action 1 is selected, send a GET request to retrieve the user profile
If action 2 is selected, send a GET request to retrieve the user's groups
If action 3 is selected, send a GET request to retrieve the specific group details
If action 4 is selected, send a POST request to split a bill among the group members
